name: TabRules
description: Automatically group tabs with your own rules. No network access, no data collection.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'
